# TokenizMyApp llms.txt

## Product
**TokenizMyApp** is a multi-tenant platform for building and managing AI-powered business applications.

## Capabilities
- Multi-tenant provisioning with isolated Neon PostgreSQL databases per tenant
- Suite mode: multiple apps per tenant sharing one database
- AI provider abstraction (OpenAI / Vercel AI Gateway / OpenCode Zen)
- Per-tenant AI provider + key + model configuration
- AI content generation pipeline (business reviews, executive summaries, dashboard data)
- Organization-level billing with plan tiers (Free, Pro, Business, Enterprise)
- AI credit metering and gating for build-time generation
- Stripe integration for payments and credit top-ups
- Custom domain support, RBAC, and role-based access control
- Multi-app suites per tenant
- Google OAuth authentication

## Use Cases
- Business dashboard and financial review
- AI chat assistant for tenant operations
- App pack generation from natural language prompts
- Template-based app creation
- Revenue tracking and credit management
- Custom domain publishing

## Plans
- **Free**: 15 AI credits/month, 1 tenant, 1 app
- **Pro**: 50 AI credits/month, 3 tenants, 5 apps per tenant, custom domains
- **Business**: 50 AI credits/month, 10 tenants, unlimited apps, RBAC, teammates
- **Enterprise**: Negotiated limits, SSO/SAML, dedicated support, custom integrations

## Authentication
- Google OAuth (SIWE) for tenant sign-in
- JWT cookie-based authentication with tier claims (pin|google)
- Platform admin exemption from credit gating

## Deployment
- Vercel deployments per tenant
- Neon PostgreSQL databases provisioned per tenant
- Custom domain mapping available on Pro+ plans

## Contact
- Platform admin email: configurable via `DEFAULT_PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAIL`
- Credit exemption: `CREDIT_EXEMPT_EMAILS` list

## Version
- Current session: 2026-08-18

---
*This llms.txt file makes the product legible to AI assistants that increasingly mediate discovery. For more information, see the Monetization & Credits Roadmap at docs/MONETIZATION-CREDITS-ROADMAP.md.*
